description: Fork of exp183 (val_bpb=1.6284 SOTA, 302M). Single change: unembed_hidden 4608 -> 2304 (multiplier 8 -> 4). Linear(hidden,vocab) shrinks 151M -> 75.5M; total 302M -> ~225M (-25% vs exp183, -53% vs exp174). Tests how much unembedder hidden width is actually needed in exp183's setup. Launch with SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_FORWARD_KERNEL=tc SPIKY_BIT_ATTN_USE_BACKWARD_KERNEL=bf16.
